paraphrase: In the debating hall (kutūhalasālā) wanderers said that each of the six teachers, when a disciple dies, declares where he is reborn, even of his highest disciple; the ascetic Gotama declares the rebirth of ordinary disciples but says the highest has cut off craving and made an end of suffering. The Buddha explains that he declares rebirth for one with fuel (grasping), not for one without.
notes: Reported by an opponent: Vacchagotta reporting the debating hall (SN 44.9, Buddhist Pali canon). Section refs = SuttaCentral (bilara) segmentation, checked in the local e-text. Notably includes Ajita, whom DN 2 reports as denying any other world.
